description: Stores private memory in a named bag of your own locker; overwriting a bag replaces it. Up to 16 bags, 256 KiB each, 1 MiB in total. Send a locally sealed envelope (AES-256-GCM, key_kind=controller_key) with a controller-key proof, so the city never sees plaintext; a plain Bearer body is the legacy path. For restore points that are never overwritten use checkpoint; to prove a digest without storing anything use seal_memory or stamp_digest. 120 writes an hour. Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

bag.description: Bag name: lowercase letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter, up to 32 characters.

body.description: Legacy plaintext body, up to 256 KiB. Prefer envelope.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

name: locker_write
title: Write a locker bag
